why_it_passes: A run action restarts the stuck service on Bea's ready machine, so the press does the whole thing; the card says what is broken, what the restart costs and what waiting costs.

card.title: Restart the stuck photo uploader on your studio Mac?
card.context: The service that uploads clinic photos to patient records has been stuck since 9 am; about 120 photos are waiting. It runs on your studio Mac. Restarting it usually clears it; the waiting photos then upload within a few minutes.
card.question: Should zm restart the photo uploader on your studio Mac now?

choices.label: Restart it now
choices.pros: the 120 waiting photos upload in minutes
choices.cons: any photo mid-upload is retried, so it arrives a minute later

choices.label: Wait until tonight
choices.cons: clinic staff cannot see today's photos until tomorrow morning

card.why: Staff need today's photos today; a restart costs at most a minute's delay on one photo.

action.shown: If you choose A, this command runs on studio, as you: launchctl kickstart -k gui/501/com.example.photo-uploader. Any other answer does nothing.
